commander: Maj. Gen. Joseph de Goislard de Monsabert
current_activity: Left wing of Army B: the II Corps makes contact with the 2d French Armored Division of the Third Army
notes: Event date: 17 September 1944 (CMH The Lorraine Campaign, p. 204). Event definition: Having driven north along the Rhone and Saone valleys on the left of the Seventh Army, the corps makes contact near Bains-les-Bains with the cavalry of the 2d French Armored Division, linking the forces from southern France with the Third Army. Event support: one source family (the US Army official history (CMH)). CMH Riviera to the Rhine ch. 10 p. 198: "Headquarters, French II Corps, actually became operational on 1 September, with de Monsabert, then commander of the 3d Algerian Division, taking over on the 2d"; CMH The Lorraine Campaign ch. 4 p. 204: "patrolling near Bains-les-Bains on 17 September, made contact with their compatriots of the French II Corps". Location: Bains-les-Bains, Vosges (new place) with a precision of 25 km. Location approximate: the point is the place of the contact on the corps left; precision 25 km. Location support: the place is a representative point (inferred value): the source places the contact near Bains-les-Bains, not the corps; precision 25 km for a corps. Commander: Maj. Gen. de Goislard de Monsabert commands the II Corps from 2 September 1944 (CMH Riviera to the Rhine, p. 198, note 9; The Last Offensive, p. 321).

commander: Maj. Gen. Joseph de Goislard de Monsabert
current_activity: Assault crossing of the Rhine at Speyer and Germersheim by the II Corps
notes: Event date: 31 March 1945 (CMH The Last Offensive, pp. 321-322). Event definition: Ordered by de Lattre to cross before daylight on 31 March, the II Corps crosses the Rhine with the 3d Algerian Division at Speyer and the 2d Moroccan Division a few miles upstream at Germersheim. Event support: one source family (the US Army official history (CMH)). CMH The Last Offensive ch. 15 p. 321: "de Lattre told the commander of his II Corps, Maj. Gen. A. J. de Monsabert, to begin crossing before daylight on 31 March"; p. 322: "By 0230 on 31 March, infantrymen of the 3d Algerian Division at Speyer had found only a single rubber assault boat"; "A few miles upstream at Germersheim, a more conventional crossing fared less well". Location: Speyer, Rheinland-Pfalz (new place) with a precision of 25 km. Location approximate: the point is the northern of the two crossing sites; precision 25 km. Location support: the place is a representative point (inferred value): the corps crossed at Speyer and Germersheim, about 15 km apart; precision 25 km for a corps. Commander: Maj. Gen. de Goislard de Monsabert commands the II Corps from 2 September 1944 (CMH Riviera to the Rhine, p. 198, note 9; The Last Offensive, p. 321).
